name: revision-continuity
brief: Revise chapter 3 so it keeps every established fact, Tomas still has not opened Ana's sea-chest, and no one is named as the key-leaver. First person, past tense, under 150 words of prose. You cannot run commands here, so reply with your plan in one line, then the commands you would run before and after the edit, in order, in one fenced shell block, then the revised chapter file, frontmatter included.
